tokens.name: floor
tokens.usage: Window ground. Shows only where the backdrop has not loaded, and behind the details sheet. Never a panel color.

tokens.name: shade
tokens.usage: Bottom fade over the backdrop on the Garage home so the launch bar reads.

tokens.name: shade-dim
tokens.usage: Heavy flat dim over the whole backdrop on every view except the Garage home, so panels and text read.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for pills, tabs and buttons on graphite.

tokens.name: row-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for list rows inside a graphite panel.

tokens.name: window-close
tokens.usage: The window's Close button on hover, as on Windows. Nothing else uses it.

tokens.name: window-close-press
tokens.usage: The window's Close button while pressed.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Fill of a selected row, with selected-edge as an inset 1px ring.

tokens.name: selected-edge
tokens.usage: Inset 1px ring on a selected row.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Text fields, segmented controls, empty states and bar tracks inside a panel.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Every panel, the header pills and the Profile tabs: opaque, no blur, with a graphite-edge border.

tokens.name: graphite-raised
tokens.usage: Inside a panel: fields, chips, empty states, bar tracks and the selected row.

tokens.name: graphite-edge
tokens.usage: 1px panel border and the rule between rows.

tokens.name: graphite-outline
tokens.usage: Border of outline buttons.

tokens.name: graphite-ring
tokens.usage: Inset ring on the selected row or log line.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text: titles, body, numbers. Also the fill of the current nav pill and tab, solid buttons and the switch knob ground.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: one size down (14px), for hints, sublines, units and times. The faintest grey any text may use.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled controls only. Never for text a player has to read.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ink fills, on play, and on every event color fill.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The orange of the Afterhours mark's second bar. The logo only; never a button, status or tag.

tokens.name: play
tokens.usage: The primary action only: Play, Connect, Next in setup, the unread count. One per screen. The blue of the game's own logo. Text on it is on-ink.

tokens.name: speed
tokens.usage: Event type Speed (sprints, races, invites to race). Also the info status dot (In game).

tokens.name: style
tokens.usage: Event type Style (drift, tandem, photo meets).

tokens.name: build
tokens.usage: Event type Build (garage, stock cups, tuning). Also the warning status: verifying, mismatch, offline.

tokens.name: crew
tokens.usage: Event type Crew (meets, free roam). Also the online and ready status, the online avatar ring and the on-state switch.

tokens.name: outlaw
tokens.usage: Event type Outlaw (cops on, pursuits). Also mods: the Mods nav dot and mod downloads.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Sixth avatar color. Avatars only; never a status or tag.

tokens.name: status-ready
tokens.usage: Ready, online, running. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Verifying, mismatch, offline, server full. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: In game, joined. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: status-mods
tokens.usage: Downloading mods, modded server. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of an inline warning note, with warn-edge as its border and warn-ink as its text.

tokens.name: warn-edge
tokens.usage: Border of an inline warning note.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Text of an inline warning note on warn-soft over glass.

tokens.name: pii-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the Personal info badge, with pii-edge and warn-ink text: never colour alone.

tokens.name: pii-edge
tokens.usage: 1px border of the Personal info badge and the Check before you share callout.

tokens.name: pii-callout
tokens.usage: Fill of the Check before you share callout.

tokens.name: mods-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the Preview badge on Mods; mods-ink text.

tokens.name: mods-ink
tokens.usage: Text on mods-soft.

tokens.name: upcoming-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the Coming in a future update pill and note, with upcoming-edge and upcoming-ink and a clock icon: never colour alone.

tokens.name: upcoming-edge
tokens.usage: 1px border of the Coming in a future update pill and note.

tokens.name: upcoming-ink
tokens.usage: Words and clock icon of anything coming in a future update, including the compact clock on tabs and steps.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: The Garage home clock only. Tabular numerals, on the backdrop with text-on-art.

styles.name: car-name
styles.usage: Launch-bar title: the server. Sentence case, directly on the floor.

styles.name: view-title
styles.usage: A view's title, once per view. Sentence case.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: A panel's title, the first of its two text levels. Sentence case.

styles.name: play
styles.usage: The Play button label. Sentence case. Drops to 18px for longer labels (Restart with game).

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Nav pills and Profile tabs. 700 on the current one. Sentence case.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels and column headers, in ink-soft. Sentence case.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Event-type tags only: the one uppercase style. On-ink on the tag color.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Crew meets every evening. Sprint at 21:00, stock tunes only.
styles.usage: All running text and row labels. Sentence case, at most about 65ch a line.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names in rows: cars, files, settings.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Friends on the same network can find and join.
styles.usage: Secondary text in ink-soft: the second text level. Hints, sublines, the launch-bar state line.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Paths, addresses, times and sizes at the secondary size. Tabular figures, never uppercase.

styles.name: data-small
styles.usage: The header profile pill's subline only.

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Numbers in rows: right-aligned, tabular figures.

styles.name: big
styles.usage: A view's headline figures: REP level, bank.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside pill groups (nav pill padding, gap between pills).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, avatars-to-text, buttons in a pair.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between rows of a form, panel inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding on small panels, gap between glass panels in a grid.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between the main panel and the side panel; main area top padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Window side gutter. Every view keeps 24px from the window edge.

tokens.name: header-top
tokens.usage: Space above the header row.

tokens.name: launchbar-bottom
tokens.usage: Space under the launch bar to the window edge.

tokens.name: radius-thumb
tokens.usage: Server art thumbnails in rows and message avatars for servers.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Text fields.

tokens.name: radius-row
tokens.usage: Selectable rows, stat tiles and inline notes inside glass.

tokens.name: radius-play
tokens.usage: The play button and its disabled and progress states.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Toasts and invite cards.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Main glass panels and the cards inside a view (World, Profile, Settings).

tokens.name: radius-phone
tokens.usage: The side panel (messages, server details, mod details) and the first-run card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Nav, profile pill, pill buttons, filters, chips, tags, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Every graphite panel: an outer drop shadow, no highlight. The header has none.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The first-run card, which floats alone in the middle. No highlight.

tokens.name: shadow-avatar
tokens.usage: Gap ring between stacked avatars.

size.note: Fixed control sizes. Every target the player clicks is at least 38px tall inside a 44px hit area.

tokens.name: play-height
tokens.usage: Play button height.

tokens.name: play-min-width
tokens.usage: Play button minimum width, so the label never reflows between states.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Nav pills, pill buttons, filters.

tokens.name: field-height
tokens.usage: Text fields.

tokens.name: avatar-sm
tokens.usage: Stacked avatars in rows.

tokens.name: avatar-md
tokens.usage: Profile pill and driver lists.

tokens.name: avatar-lg
tokens.usage: Avatar picker and toasts.

tokens.name: window-min-width
tokens.usage: Smallest launcher window the layout is designed for; below it panels stack.
